_meta.purpose: A4 golden set (REQUIREMENTS.md INV-22): inbound investor replies with the expected classification and, where relevant, the expected extracted buy-box fields. In this build the model is stubbed with the `model` block of each case (MockModelProvider), so the set verifies the pipeline contract and the deterministic pre/post-processing: quote stripping, auto-reply detection, unknown tracking, correction history, multi-box handling. BO-13 turns the same file into the live eval harness input by dropping the `model` blocks and comparing real model output against `expected`.

format.subject: subject line of the inbound message
format.body: raw inbound body as Graph hands it over (quoted history included where the case tests it)
format.history: earlier thread messages, oldest first, direction in|out
format.model: the structured output the stubbed model returns for classify (A4 CLASSIFY_SCHEMA)
format.expected: classification, is_auto_reply, quoted_text_stripped, reconnect_date, stripped_text_contains / stripped_text_excludes, model_called
format.extraction: optional: {current: {key: criteria}, model: EXTRACT_SCHEMA output, expected: per-box fields, unknowns, corrections}

_meta.bo13: v2 (BO-13): extraction.expected now lists every stated field (markets, cities, neighborhoods, condition, strategy, closing_timeline) so the eval harness can synthesise the model output from expected alone; every value the agent tests assert is unchanged. The harness reads this file through wholesaling.evals.cases (format inbound_replies).
